seo.title: Insurance & Cover — Protect your ZCHF | Frankencoin
seo.description: Optional third-party cover for Frankencoin (ZCHF) holders. Depeg Cover, underwritten by Nexus Mutual and available through OpenCover, pays out if ZCHF trades 10% or more below 1 CHF for seven consecutive days.

header.title: Cover for your francs.|Optional, on-chain.
header.subtitle: Independent providers insure ZCHF against a sustained loss of the peg. The cover is bought and paid out on-chain, and it is not issued by the Frankencoin Association.

products.title: ZCHF Depeg Cover
products.provider: Underwritten by Nexus Mutual · Available through OpenCover
products.description: Depeg Cover protects ZCHF holders against a sustained loss of the peg. If Frankencoin trades at least 10% below its 1 CHF reference value for seven consecutive days, covered holders can file a claim.

covered.title: What's covered
items: A sustained ZCHF depeg — a drop of 10% or more below the 1 CHF reference value that lasts at least seven consecutive days.
Losses on ZCHF held in a covered wallet for the full duration of the policy.

excluded.title: What's not covered
items: Assets other than ZCHF, the covered token.
Technical issues that do not themselves cause the depeg.
Bugs or events already known or disclosed before cover began.
“Rug pull” scenarios where protocol controllers seize funds.
ZCHF held for less than 72 hours before the depeg event.

howItWorks.title: How to get covered
steps: Open the ZCHF cover page on OpenCover and connect your wallet.
Choose how much ZCHF to protect and for how long (30 to 180 days).
Pay the premium in USDC, ETH or cbBTC and receive an on-chain proof-of-cover NFT.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: Cover products are offered by independent third parties and are not issued, guaranteed or endorsed by the Frankencoin Association. Terms, availability, pricing and payouts are determined solely by the respective provider and underwriter. Always read the full cover wording before purchasing. This page is informational only and does not constitute insurance, financial or legal advice.

cta.title: Most savers never need it. Some sleep better with it.
cta.body: Depeg cover is bought in minutes, for 30 to 180 days, paid in USDC, ETH or cbBTC.
